newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangsu Expressway optimistic on future growth.
newsitem.headline: Jiangsu Expressway optimistic on future growth.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd said underlying strong demand for transportation facilities in China's Jiangsu province was expected to boost its business growth.

"Jiangsu province is undergoing rapid economic development, demand for transportation facilities will provide substantial development potential for the company," said the Jiangsu Expressway's chairman Xu Hua Qiang in a briefing on Tuesday.

"The company will be the only listed vehicle under the Jiangsu Provincial Communications Department," Xu said. "Due to our close relations with the department, the company is well positioned to invest, construct or to acquire toll road projects on a priority basis within the province."
Jiangsu Expressway said earlier it is issuing 1.222 billion new H-shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$3.11 each in a global flotation.

Of the total issue, 6.8 percent will be offered to the public in Hong Kong, 32 percent will be earmarked for strategic placement and an international placement portion will take up the remaining 61.2 percent.
H-shares are Chinese-enterprise shares listed in Hong Kong.

"Looking ahead, Jiangsu Expressway will continue to acquire and invest in attractive projects to expand its business portfolio. The company is set to capture the exciting growth potential in Jiangsu province for years to come," Xu said.
The company said the net proceeds raised from the issue would be used mainly to acquire operation rights and to fund roads construction in the province.
Proceeds would also be used for improvement of surveillance and control of its existing toll collection systems, for loan repayment and for working capital, it said.
Jiangsu Expressway's public offering of shares in Hong Kong will run from June 18 to June 23, and dealing in the company's shares will begin on June 27.
